While their C/C++ experience (National Instruments) and embedded systems exposure are relevant, their recent work focuses heavily on web/mobile technologies (TypeScript, Node.js) with minimal alignment to the embedded networking security role. Native Japanese proficiency is not indicated.

concerns: No explicit experience with security technologies (MACsec, IEEE 802.1X, encryption systems)
